newsitem.title: USA: Conestoga to acquire Infocore Inc.
newsitem.headline: Conestoga to acquire Infocore Inc.

text.p: Conestoga Enterprises Inc said Monday that shareholders of Infocore Inc agreed to the acquisition of the company by Conestoga.
In February, Conestoga said it signed a letter of intent to buy Infocore in a deal valued at about $4.8 million.

Infocore would become a wholly-owned subsidiary of Conestoga under the agreement, which provides for Conestoga to issue 200,000 shares of common stock to Infocore shareholders in exchange for all the outstanding shares of Infocore, Conestoga said.
The deal is expected to close April 30, Conestoga said.
